messages.subject: Animals move away from observer
parts:
Hello,

In my analyses of point transect counts I find numbers that show an incre=
ase from 0 to 100 m, followed by the expected decrease. However, I do thi=
nk that detection probability is actually 1 at 0 distance and will remain=
1 for some distance. The curve that is fitted through the frequency dist=
ribution obviously does not fit the data very well (see below). However, =
I wondered whether I still should stick to this curve because I think tha=
t numbers were in fact depressed close to the observer because birds had =
shifted away. Alternatively I could make distance categories that obscure=
the effect, but I wondered whether that would improve the results.

Popko Wiersma
